name: Innovex Dry Iron IDI002
description: 1200W Innovex dry iron with non-stick coating and 1-year warranty. Lightweight and ideal for everyday ironing.
details: The Innovex IDI002 Dry Iron delivers reliable performance with 1200W power and a non-stick soleplate. It features an adjustable temperature control knob, temperature indicator, 360° pivot cord, overheat safety protection and a comfortable handle with stable heel rest. Lightweight at just 618g and backed by a 1-year warranty. Perfect for daily use in Sri Lankan homes.
